src/routes/about.tsx: About MetaTwin · The Future of the CV

A CV lists skills. A MetaTwin brings proof of capability and a team of AI employees, so the next hire arrives as a whole team. MetaTwin is how Kenya's young people become the first workforce to do it.
Employers no longer hire a CV. They hire what you can deliver.

A CV lists what you say you can do. In the age of capability, that isn't enough. Future hires need to show proof of what they've built, and bring the AI employees that help them deliver more, faster. That combination is a new kind of candidate, and Kenya's young people are ready to be the first.
The first workforce to arrive with AI employees.

Kenya's youth are creative, digital-first and hungry to build. MetaTwin gives every young Kenyan a way to turn that energy into a living record of capability, and to stand behind it with their own supervised AI team. When an employer, client or partner meets a MetaTwin, they don't meet a candidate. They meet a ready-made team.
Equip Kenyan youth to prove what they can do, and to deliver it with a team of AI employees.
A world of work where every hire arrives with proof of capability and their own AI workforce, starting in Kenya.

MetaTwin is developed by MetaGlobe Technologies Ltd. A MetaTwin represents a person's capabilities. It is not a biometric or physical replica of the individual. AI employees work under the person's supervision, and their output is never counted as the person's own evidence.

src/routes/privacy.tsx: Last updated 11 October 2026. This policy explains what MetaTwin collects, why, and how you stay in control of it.
) is operated by MetaGlobe Technologies Ltd (“MetaGlobe”, “we”, “us”). This policy covers the MetaTwin web application only.
When you create an account, we collect:
Your email address and password (or, if you sign in with Google or GitHub, the email, name and profile photo that provider shares with us).
Your birth year and a self-declared confirmation that you are 18 or older. We do not collect your full date of birth.
As you use MetaTwin, you choose to add:
Profile details: name, headline, institution, programme and year of study.
Capabilities (skills you self-report or back with evidence), projects, and evidence items (a title, and optionally a link and a note).
A public handle and visibility setting, if you choose to share a public page.

Your data is used to build and display your MetaTwin: your dashboard, your public profile (if you make one public), and — where you have added matching capabilities — a view of how you compare against opportunities listed on the platform. We don't sell your data, and we don't use it for third-party advertising.

. Only you can see your capabilities, projects and evidence unless you explicitly turn on "Make my profile public" from your dashboard. A public profile shows your name, headline, institution, programme, capabilities and projects (including each project's problem, solution, pitch deck, pitch video, write-up and project link) to anyone with your link; evidence links and notes are shown only if you separately opt in to "Also show my evidence links and evidence notes." A public profile never shows your email, birth year, age-confirmation status, or year of study.
We use a small number of service providers to run MetaTwin, each only processing what's needed to provide their service:
— our database, authentication and backend host.
— only if you choose to sign in with one of them, subject to their own privacy policies.
We don't sell or rent your data to anyone else.

Passwords are handled entirely by our authentication provider and are never visible to us in plain text. Access to your data is restricted at the database level so that, by default, only you can read or write your own records.

You can edit or remove most of your profile data at any time from your dashboard, and turn your public profile on or off whenever you like. To request deletion of your account and associated data, email us at the address below — we don't yet have a self-service "delete my account" button, so for now this is handled manually.
MetaTwin is currently for students aged 18 and over. We don't knowingly collect data from anyone under 18.
If we make a material change to this policy, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
